cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a flexible water-based bitumen waterproofing membrane. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is a versatile multi-use product that is fast drying and can be applied by brush, roller, trowel or airless spray equipment on horizontal and vertical surfaces.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. The substrate surface must be continuous, all projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 can be mixed with sand and cement or pre-bagged mortar mix to form a screed to falls or patching render with improved adhesion and tensile properties.
Sheeting
Fibrous cement sheeting must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation directions. Concrete

Concrete must be allowed to cure for 28 days and cement render and sand and cement screeds must be allowed to cure for 7 days prior to the application. Surfaces must be even and smooth, imperfections repaired with a suitable Sika® MonoTop repair mortar. Metals
Metal surfaces shall be thoroughly cleaned and free of dust, existing coatings, contaminants and any signs of oxidation or rust must be removed before application of Ormonoid Bitkote No.3.
Priming

Dry porous substrates must be primed using a dilute 1 part Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 to 1 part water, work well into the substrate to ensure adequate penetration, avoid ponding. Allow to dry prior to general application. If moisture is present, allow for application of Sikalastic Moisture Seal, refer to PDS for application rates.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Substrates
cl.x: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 can be applied to the following substrates: ▪ Concrete; ▪ Masonry; ▪ Sand/cement screeds; ▪ Fibrous cement sheeting; ▪ Compressed fibrous cement sheeting; ▪ Steel/Aluminium; ▪ Timber posts

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: Single component, ready to use undiluted, prior to application thoroughly mix using a mechanical mixer to produce a homogenous liquid.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Remove liquid coating immediately with a dry cloth, clean tools and equipment with water while the material is still wet. Cured coating can only be removed mechanically.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Considerations > Limitations
s: Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is not designed to stop a hydrostatic head of water pressure.
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is not suitable for use in immersed or tanking applications.
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be used over damp, wet or contaminated substrates.
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be applied if it is raining or if rain is imminent.
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be applied directly over protective coatings.
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 must not be used as a trafficable coating.
Ormonoid Bitkote No.3 is not compatible with polyurethane or silicone sealants.
For retaining walls allow a minimum of 3 days cure and suitable protection layer prior to backfilling.
Do not apply where the substrate temperature is below 10°C or greater than 35°C.
Contact Sika Technical Service for advice if further information is required.
